weather_report:
As the chill of the late night lingers over Downtown San Francisco, the sky reveals a thick veil of clouds, a muted gray hinting at a slowly awakening morning. The forecast, however, promises a transformation. As the sun nudges its way to the forefront, the day will unfold mostly sunny, embracing a temperature near 63 degrees. The winds, fresh from the southwest, will introduce a playful vigor to the stillness, rustling the trees and gently tousling hair—an invitation to step outside.

For those emerging from the warmth of their blankets, a light jacket or sweater will serve well against the remnants of a cool breeze, especially in the early hours. By midday, as the sun casts its golden rays, a simple layers approach will suffice, allowing one to shed warmth gradually. Exploring the city's charming cafés, tucked into bright alleyways, or wandering along the waterfront to soak in the vitality of the bay's glimmering surface could be the perfect way to embrace this day. This vibrant yet tranquil atmosphere embodies the spirit of San Francisco, inviting everyone to seek the little joys nestled within the city’s embrace.
